title: Extract Fourier-tail and truncation norm diagnostics
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed periodic-domain diagnostic task only; it does not define a truncation acceptance criterion or activate implementation.
objective: Extract domain-owned Fourier coefficient tail, omitted-weight, and reconstruction norm diagnostics from periodic calculations while retaining explicit transform normalization and geometry conventions.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, define retained and omitted coefficient sets, Fourier normalization, coefficient units, geometry indexing, per-block norms, and aggregate reconstruction diagnostics.
Own truncation interpretation in the periodic analysis or campaign layer while reusing lower-level norm mechanics.
Migrate only identical diagnostics demonstrated by at least two actual periodic consumers.
completion_criteria: Fourier-tail and reconstruction records state transform convention, retained set, omitted set, units, and aggregation formula.
Synthetic exact-transform and controlled-tail tests verify the documented mathematics.
Migrated periodic retained artifacts remain unchanged or any unavoidable wire change is separately authorized.
exclusions: Do not classify a small Fourier tail as scientific validation, locality proof, or transferability evidence.
Do not hide periodic geometry or transform policy inside the generic norm analyzer.
No production Wannier90 or electronic-structure execution, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
